shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat surface
human figure elements (A: robed body and hands holding objects; B: anthropomorphic/face-like signs within glyph blocks)
horizontal registers/rows of repeated units (A: rosette band; B: rows of glyph blocks)
rosette/roundel-like circular motifs (A: petalled rosettes; B: rounded elements within glyphs)
justification: Both are shallow relief surfaces that organise motifs into horizontal registers, and both include anthropomorphic elements and rounded, petal-like forms, but these are generic traits. A depicts a large-scale naturalistic standing human figure in drapery with handheld objects above a border of petalled rosettes, whereas B is entirely a grid of compact abstract sign-blocks with rounded compartmented interiors and no continuous figural scene.
